notes.title: Version 4.0.0 - Pals Pack Release and Online Beta!
notes.content:
We’re releasing the Pals Pack DLC publicly on Steam, and hosting an open public Beta of Online Versus for TWO WEEKS!  The Pals Pack is chockfull of other content like new challenges for you and your best buds to tackle, hats,  items, endless mode updates, a secret new playable character, and quality of life updates!  
New Online Versus Beta!
 A rotating game mode changes periodically; however, this can be changed on the character select screen (with the exception of ranked)


 Standard: Regular Matchmaking, fight a random player!


 Ranked: Ranked matchmaking, gain/lose rank with each battle and fight players of similar rank. In ranked both players use the same seed.


 Friends: Invite a friend and fight it out!


 Customization: Select a custom frame, banner and a style of junk blocks! You can also select up to four emotes to use in online matches.


 VS Stats: Track your winrate, favourite characters and more!


 VS mods: If both you and your opponent have the same mods enabled, they can be synced for online play!


 Note: Mods need to be downloaded from the Steam Workshop to work

New Versus Modes
Race: First to complete three stages wins!


 Gem Haul: First to earn 30,000 gems wins!


 Item Craze: Survival, way more items spawn


 Volleybomb: Juggle a giant bomb while clearing your board. If the bomb touches the opponent’s board, you earn a point! First to three points wins.


 Marathon: Survival, units spawn in waves.


 Legendary: Survival, with units and hazards form the Legendary Path


 Random: A random game mode will be selected each game.

Chester’s Choice
 A setting in Versus that has Chester choose a random game settings to activate each battle!

New Versus Items
 Warping Glass: Teleport units around you towards the opponent’s board.

 Frost Bellow: Freezes the opponent’s board for 7 turns and the player for 5 turns. 

 Wobble Wand: For 10 turns, the opponent inputs are inverted.

 Slamvil: Throws a giant anvil to the opponent.

 Confuser: Transform an entire row on the opponent’s board into junk blocks. 

 Cube of Zorix: Shoots a laser horizontally on both boards. Deals damage to players.

Versus Changes
 CPU improvements


 CPU now has a level 10 difficulty (that blatantly cheats)


 “Shuffle All” is now the default level setting. Stage order is fully randomized and its difficulty is adjusted for how early/late the stage is in a match. The music for the match will be that of the first stage.


 Junk now scales with the gem meter. Chains send more junk with each bar of gem meter.


 Exit door now sends 4 junk instead of 8; however, it sends an additional 4 junk per stage ahead of the opponent.

New Custom Hat presets
 You can now create and save your own custom presets for your favourite hats! Pick up to 12 different hats per preset, equip them all with the press of a button and label them with their own preset names.

New Hats
 Summoning Slouch: Random units spawn occasionally.


Monstrous Montera: Transform into a monster.


 Dungstalker: Beetos spawn everywhere.


Spinwulf Snood: Move two tiles at a time.


No-Peek Nightcap: The UI is gone.


 Extrovert Hat: Can’t attack loner foes or blocks.

Updated Endless Mode
 You can now set the starting loop for endless mode from the hub. This will only affect the endless route and not other game modes (to do that, you can go into Settings -> Adventure)


 After loop 1, you’ll be able to meet Chester in Plains even after reaching the relic limit. This works until you amass 32 or more relics.


 When skipping loops, Chester will provide you an assortment of relics to choose from to give you a head start.


 Loop difficulty changes:
- Loop 1: Legendary units may show up
- Loop 2: Legendary hazards and big units may show up.
- Loop 3: Legendary units, big units and hazards show up more frequently. Future loops increase this chance.
- Random units start showing up rarely, increasing slightly in frequency each loop.
- Durability slightly decreases each loop starting on loop 5.
- One less chest each stage starting on loop 10.
- HP scales more on loops beyond 10.

Changes
 Prism Knight’s clones spawn with one more HP.


 Scrap Knight B no longer teleports units around if she moves after tossing her bag.


 Knights now have a waiting animation while fast-forwarding.

Bug Fixes
 Fixed King Knight’s bash didn’t deal damage when bashing water tiles.


 Fixed Shield Knight B wouldn’t recover her shield after defeating the Enchantress


 Fixed Cogslotters wouldn’t drop their cog if flipped.


 Miscellaneous fixes.

notes.title: MODFEST COMMUNITY EVENT
notes.content:
Ready your digits, tinkerers! 

You’re invited to our first-ever Pocket Dungeon Modfest Community Event!

Last month we announced the release of the Early Preview of the Paradox Pack DLC with the long awaited Mod Support feature! This feature allows folks at home to edit the game in fun ways - changing up gameplay styles, adding your character sprites, levels, Relics, color palettes, and more! Our community has already been tinkering away at it and we’re blown away with the creativity. 

With that said…Shovel Knight Pocket Dungeon’s 2nd anniversary is on the horizon! What better way to celebrate than by putting the spotlight on the community’s incredible creations and giving them a whirl on our live stream?

The stream will take place on the anniversary on December 13th at 2pm PT/ 5pm ET! This is all in good fun. We look forward to a load of laughs, gaffs, and having a great time with you on Stream.

EVENT DETAILS:


 The stream will be held on our Twitch Channel: twitch.tv/yachtclubgames
 You can submit your Mod at anytime between now and December 12th! We'll be playing them on Stream on Dec 13th at 2pm PT!
 Anyone can participate in modding, as long as you own the base game


For more information on how to participate, keep scrollin’!

How to Participate


 Join the Early Preview on Steam! For directions on how to access it CLICK HERE

 Create your Mod! For directions on how to create your mod, CLICK HERE

 Submit your Mod to Steam Workshop. CLICK HERE

 Hang out with us on Stream on December 13th at 2pm PT/5pm ET. The mods will also be available for you to check out at home. STREAM LINK

FAQ: 
What is Mod Support?
Mod support allows players to add their own content to the game. Note: This feature is only for the PC version of the DLC.

Where can I submit my Mod?
You can submit it on the Steam Workshop page.

Is this event available on consoles too?
It is not! Mod Support will only be available on the PC version of this game.

Do I need to own Shovel Knight Pocket Dungeon to participate?
Yes you do. The Mods are only compatible with the Steam version of this game.

How long is the event?
The event will start at 2pm PT and will  last for 2 hours on December 13th. If the event is over, do not fret! Mod Support is forever so you’ll be able to play at home whenever!

When is the cut off for submitting Mods?
The cut off date for submitting your mods for us to play on stream is December 12th 11:59pm. Once the event is over, you are still encouraged to submit your mods for the community to play! 

Are there any limitations to the Mods?
Yes, you'll need to heed Steam's Community Stands for Mods! 

How do I access the Paradox Pack DLC Early Preview and Mod Support Content?
Check out this handy dandy guide HERE

Is there a prize for best Mod?
Eternal glory and a digital high five! This community event is just for fun! We aren’t judging the Mods on any sort of criteria. We’re just excited to see all the cool stuff you create. 

Can I play the Mods at home?
Of course you can!


Note: To participate in this event, you will need to own the base game on Steam. You will also need to join the Early Preview branch of the game!

notes.title: Shovel Knight Pocket Dungeon Puzzler's Pack FREE DLC Launches on June 6th!
notes.content:
Mark your calendars, folks - our puzzle-tastic DLC arrives on June 6th! This thrilling new content in Shovel Knight Pocket Dungeon will launch on Steam! The FREE DLC Pack is GIGANTIC! It includes new playable characters, formidable "Quandary Challenges," neat new Relics, robust run modifiers, and expansive new areas to explore! In true Yacht Club Games fashion, we’re releasing the pack completely FREE -- fans only need the base game to enjoy all the new content. This is just the first of three free DLC releases planned for the title, so there’s much much more to come.


Puzzler’s Pack NEW Content Overview

 New Playable Characters:

Puzzle Knight - Everyone’s favorite puzzle prodigy is now a playable character! While on your run, you’ll be able to rotate surrounding foes clockwise to create convenient new combos! 
Mona -The green queen of Alchemy can now embark on her very own Pocket Dungeon adventure! Utilize her awesome alchemist abilities by exploding nearby potions. Chain them to get more bang for your buck!


 New Battles, Boons, and Bosses:
 Keep your wits as sharp as your shovel, as new obstacles of all types await you in every level!


 New Relics:
 Chester has “found” a TON of new Relics to aid you in your quest! Make sure to take ‘em for a spin.


 New Areas to Explore:  

Hedge Farm - An earthy plot of land has appeared in the Pocket Dungeon! Ready that green thumb of yours, the wholesome Hedge Farmer needs some agricultural assistance!
Castle Quandary - Uncover a wealth of quests and content far above the Pocket Dungeon! Scale a colossal beanstalk to discover a confounding castle nestled in the clouds.


 New Quests:
 Castle Quandary offers unique quests for each character. Completing these Quandary Challenges (Legendary Path, Character Quest, Trial of Offerings, and Refract Realm) will unlock new costumes, abilities, and more!


 Marathon Mode: 
Battle endless waves of enemies in a desperate bid for survival! Enemy configurations will change between stages, but the battle never ends. How long can you last?


 Mr. Hat’s Fancy Shop: 
How resplendent! A well-tailored traveler has wandered into the Pocket Dungeon, replete with wares. Mr. Hat will provide you with various headpieces that modify your game in scores of wacky ways! There are TONS of run modifiers to purchase!


 Secret Content:
 We’ve thrown so many secrets, too. It’s probably not even possible to find them all…


 New Features & Quality of Life Improvements: 
We’ve added Set Seeds, Weekly Challenges, Bump Assists (Think Bumper Bowling! It’s a cool new mode to stop you from dying!), Cutscene skips, and more!


 New Feats: 
Calling all completionists! We’ve added a ton of new feats for you to collect as you adventure through all of this sweet sweet content.

We hope you enjoy your puzzling adventure on June 6th!

Puzzler’s Pack NEW Content Overview

Available Now
New Playable Characters:

 Puzzle Knight - Everyone’s favorite puzzle prodigy is now a playable character! While on your run, you’ll be able to rotate surrounding foes clockwise to create convenient new combos! 
 Mona - Our green mini-game queen can now embark on her very own Pocket Dungeon adventure! Utilize her awesome alchemist abilities by exploding nearby potions. Chain them to get more bang for your buck! 



New Areas to Explore

 Hedge Farm - An earthy plot of land has appeared in the Pocket Dungeon! Ready that green thumb of yours, the wholesome Hedge Farmer needs some agricultural assistance!
 Castle Quandary - Uncover a brand new secret quest in the Pocket Dungeon! Scale a colossal beanstalk to discover a confounding castle nestled in the clouds



New Quests
In the Quandary Castle,  you’ll unlock unique challenges called “Quandry Runs” for each playable character! Note: Only 2 out of the 4 quests are accessible with Shovel Knight.


New Relics
Chester dug up 2  new Relics to aid you in your quest! Test 'em out on your run!

Coming Soon

 Mr. Hat Shop: Whoa! A well-tailored traveler has wandered into the Pocket Dungeon. He’ll sell you various headpieces that modify your runs! There will be 20+ run modifiers to purchase!
 Mod Support: Mod support will allow players to add their own content to the game. This feature will only be for the PC version. 
 Refract Abilities: Challenge yourself with new takes on your favorite character’s abilities! Variety is the spice of life!

notes.title: 1.1.0 March patch - New options, features, balance adjustments, and bug fixes
notes.content:

New

Balance
Knights

Relics

 Zap Wand shoots more powerfully
